VBO:0200162.summary: Bichon names a companion-dog family that includes the Bichon Frise, Maltese, Havanese and Bolognese. The FCI groups these four together, while placing the Coton de Tuléar and Little Lion Dog in neighboring subgroups.
VBO:0200162.shortDescription: The Bichon family includes the Frise, Maltese, Havanese and Bolognese, each a distinct companion breed.

sources.title: FCI — Companion and Toy Dogs
sources.evidence: Read section1 and subgroups1.1–1.3: four named Bichons versus neighboring Coton and Little Lion; registry classification supports category only, no shared character.
